source.public_versification_note: Public and Hebrew numbering align throughout Leviticus 8–10. The full original XML record at 9:22 includes both the written hand and read hands forms.

key_decisions.decision: Retains eighth-day transition after seven-day ordination and all three groups summoned.
Keeps Aaron’s two animal categories and defect prohibition applying to both.
Retains nested instruction through Aaron, male goat and exact one-year qualification of calf and lamb.
Completes continuing list with ox/ram, grain/oil and same-day appearance promise to Israelites.
Preserves atonement for people in both clauses rather than correcting first occurrence to household.
Retains people’s distinct goat and comparison with prior calf without forcing every disposal detail identical.
Preserves handful and additive relation to morning offering, not replacing daily service.
Keeps combined fat inventory with tail naturally belonging to ram, carrying list into placement verse without attributing tail to ox.
Follows qere hands over written singular hand, retains direction, blessing and all three completed offering categories.
Preserves divine-origin fire and consuming action, all-people response and physical prostration, linking same verbs to 10:2.
